name: The Server Room
body:
Anchors the wing. Pandora's archive glowing soft behind Jade's volleyball trophies — two server racks, UPS mounting, maintenance desk, cable trays, ventilation and mini-split cooling, in a sealed chamber connected directly to the Jade and Pandora suite.

The Ghosts' digital archive lives here. So does three hundred and thirty-four terabytes of material Pandora would describe as REFERENCE. The whole Left Cheek sleeps to the sound of the fans.
